metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Security Property Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of formal security properties with 100% coverage of all nodes and edges in the Program Graph. Each graph element has at least one associated property with formal reachability analysis.

property_categories.SOUNDNESS: Properties ensuring cryptographic proof systems cannot be forged
property_categories.INTEGRITY: Properties ensuring data cannot be corrupted or manipulated
property_categories.AUTHORIZATION: Properties ensuring only authorized actors can perform actions
property_categories.MONOTONICITY: Properties ensuring values only increase or decrease as required
property_categories.BOUNDARY_SECURITY: Properties ensuring trust boundaries are properly enforced
property_categories.STATE_INVARIANT: Properties that must hold at specific program states
property_categories.TRANSITION_SECURITY: Properties that must hold during state transitions
property_categories.DATA_PROTECTION: Properties ensuring data confidentiality and integrity in transit

properties.property: STATE-USER-IDLE represents an untrusted actor. Any transition from this state must be validated by receiving components.
properties.anti_property: An attacker at STATE-USER-IDLE can cause state changes in trusted components without validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: All transitions from STATE-USER-IDLE lead to action nodes that perform validation before state changes. The protocol design ensures untrusted user inputs are validated at every trust boundary crossing.
properties.notes: Initial user state - foundation for user-initiated flows.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING can only be reached after successful completion of unwrap operations or external token acquisition.
properties.anti_property: A user can reach STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING without proper token transfer from LiquidityManager.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure ensures STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING is only reachable via EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING from STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE, which requires successful unwrap operation completion.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 can only be reached via successful wrap operation or teleport completion.
properties.anti_property: A user can reach STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 without proper minting through LiquidityManager or Verifier.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths to STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 require successful completion of wrap (STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE) or teleport (STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE) operations.

properties.property: STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP requires valid wrap request with amount bounds within BN254 field constraints.
properties.anti_property: LiquidityManager processes wrap request with amount exceeding 2^248-1.
properties.reachability_rationale: The zERC20 contract enforces value <= 2^248-1 constraint in _afterTokenTransfer hook. Any wrap resulting in balance exceeding this limit will revert.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD must use floor rounding for rewards to prevent protocol loss.
properties.anti_property: Reward calculation uses ceiling rounding allowing users to extract more than entitled.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib.computeIncentive implementation uses floor division for rewards, ensuring protocol never overpays.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY must successfully transfer exact requested amount from user.
properties.anti_property: LiquidityManager receives different amount than transferred due to fee-on-transfer token.
properties.reachability_rationale: If a fee-on-transfer token is used as underlying, the actual received amount will differ from transferFrom amount. This is mitigated by deployment policy prohibiting FoT tokens, but implementation does not enforce this check.
properties.notes: CRITICAL: FoT tokens NOT SUPPORTED. Deployment responsibility.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 can only be executed by authorized minter address.
properties.anti_property: Unauthorized address invokes mint function on zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20.mint() includes onlyMinter modifier that verifies msg.sender == minter(). Only LiquidityManager contract is set as minter during deployment.

properties.property: STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE implies underlying tokens are held by LiquidityManager and zERC20 minted to user.
properties.anti_property: STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE reached without proper token custody transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure requires sequential execution of ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY and ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 before reaching STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE.

properties.property: STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP requires user to hold sufficient zERC20 balance for requested unwrap amount.
properties.anti_property: User can initiate unwrap for more zERC20 than they hold.
properties.reachability_rationale: ERC20 transfer mechanics ensure user cannot transfer more tokens than their balance. The burn operation in unwrap will revert if balance insufficient.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE must use ceiling rounding to prevent protocol loss from fee undercollection.
properties.anti_property: Fee calculation uses floor rounding allowing users to pay less than required fee.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib.computeIncentive implementation uses ceiling division for fees, ensuring protocol never undercollects.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 can only be executed by authorized minter address.
properties.anti_property: Unauthorized address invokes burn function on zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20.burn() includes onlyMinter modifier that verifies msg.sender == minter().

properties.property: ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING transfers (amount - fee) where fee is correctly computed.
properties.anti_property: User receives incorrect underlying amount after unwrap.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential graph structure ensures fee calculation completes before transfer. Transfer amount is computed atomically within same transaction.

properties.property: STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE implies zERC20 burned and underlying transferred to user minus fee.
properties.anti_property: STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE reached without burn completion or transfer execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Atomic transaction ensures all operations complete or revert together.

properties.property: STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY is reached when amount > underlyingBalance - feeSurplus.
properties.anti_property: Unwrap succeeds when insufficient underlying liquidity exists.
properties.reachability_rationale: Liquidity check is performed before transfer. Contract maintains solvency by reverting insufficient liquidity unwraps.

properties.property: STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER requires sender to have sufficient zERC20 balance.
properties.anti_property: Transfer initiated without sufficient sender balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: ERC20 _transfer reverts on insufficient balance before any state change.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces value <= 2^248-1 for BN254 field compatibility.
properties.anti_property: Transfer succeeds with value > 2^248-1 corrupting ZK circuit compatibility.
properties.reachability_rationale: The _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20 includes ValueTooLarge revert check for any value exceeding MAX_VALUE (2^248-1).

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES correctly decrements sender and increments recipient by exact transfer value.
properties.anti_property: Balance update results in incorrect totals (conservation of value violated).
properties.reachability_rationale: OpenZeppelin ERC20 implementation guarantees balance conservation through atomic operations with overflow checks.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN appends (to, value) using SHA-256 with truncation to 248 bits.
properties.anti_property: Hash chain update uses incorrect hash function or truncation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Implementation uses sha256 with explicit truncation. Hash chain provides deterministic commitment to transfer history.
properties.notes: Hash chain integrity for ZK proofs.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits monotonically increasing index values.
properties.anti_property: IndexedTransfer event emitted with non-sequential or duplicate index.
properties.reachability_rationale: Index is incremented atomically (index++) in each transfer. No external control over index value.
properties.notes: Event indexing for Merkle tree construction.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE implies balances updated, hash chain updated, and IndexedTransfer emitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE reached with incomplete state updates.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential graph structure ensures all actions complete before reaching terminal state.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE is reached when value > 2^248-1.
properties.anti_property: Valid transfer rejected as ValueTooLarge.
properties.reachability_rationale: Comparison is exact: value > MAX_VALUE leads to revert, value <= MAX_VALUE proceeds to balance update.

properties.property: STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE is the default state ready to process hash chain reservations and proofs.
properties.anti_property: Verifier stuck in non-idle state blocking protocol operations.
properties.reachability_rationale: Verifier operations are stateless per-call. No persistent state blocks future operations.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN stores immutable checkpoint for future proof public input binding.
properties.anti_property: Reserved checkpoint modified after storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: reservedHashChains mapping is append-only. No function exists to modify existing entries.
properties.notes: Hash chain checkpoint for proof binding.

properties.property: STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED implies checkpoint stored in reservedHashChains mapping.
properties.anti_property: STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED reached without successful storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission follows successful storage. Transaction atomicity ensures consistency.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF requires prior hash chain reservation at target index.
properties.anti_property: Transfer root proof submitted without corresponding hash chain reservation.
properties.reachability_rationale: proveTransferRoot validates reservedHashChains[index] exists before proof verification.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF invokes IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof with correct public inputs.
properties.anti_property: Proof verification bypassed or invoked with incorrect public inputs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Solidity code calls verifier contract with explicit public input construction. Groth16 verifier implements SNARK soundness.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED can only be reached after successful ZKP verification.
properties.anti_property: Transfer root stored without valid cryptographic proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure requires ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF to complete successfully before reaching STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED.

properties.property: STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED is reached only when two valid proofs yield different roots for same index.
properties.anti_property: Emergency triggered by single proof or invalid proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Emergency requires: (1) existing proved root at index, (2) new valid proof, (3) roots differ. If ZK system is sound, divergent proofs indicate implementation bug.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF requires valid teleport request with proof data.
properties.anti_property: Teleport processing initiated without proof submission.
properties.reachability_rationale: Function signature requires proof parameter. Empty proof will fail verification.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE checks root exists in provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots.
properties.anti_property: Teleport proceeds with root reference not in any proved/global root mapping.
properties.reachability_rationale: Implementation explicitly checks root existence and reverts with RootNotFound if absent.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH ensures proof recipient matches msg.sender derived hash.
properties.anti_property: Teleport mints to recipient not bound to proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Recipient hash is computed from GeneralRecipient which binds chain_id, address, and tweak. Proof public inputs include this hash.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces newTotalTeleported > totalTeleported[recipient].
properties.anti_property: Teleport succeeds with non-increasing totalTeleported (double-spend).
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL: Implementation checks newTotal > oldTotal and reverts otherwise. This prevents double-spending by ensuring each teleport advances the monotonic counter.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF verifies Nova or Groth16 proof of withdrawal claim.
properties.anti_property: Withdrawal proceeds with invalid or forged proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Withdrawal decider contracts implement Groth16 verification. ZKP soundness ensures forged proofs are rejected with overwhelming probability.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT invokes zERC20.teleport() with delta = newTotal - oldTotal.
properties.anti_property: Teleport called with incorrect delta amount.
properties.reachability_rationale: Delta computation is: newTotalTeleported - totalTeleported[recipient]. This is computed atomically in same function call.

properties.property: STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE implies valid proof verified, monotonicity checked, and tokens minted to correct recipient.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE reached with invalid proof or incorrect minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure ensures all validation actions complete before reaching completion state.

properties.property: STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED is reached when any validation step fails (root, recipient, monotonicity, proof).
properties.anti_property: Teleport silently fails without proper error indication.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is a failure state reached through explicit revert paths. Proper rejection is the security property.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT sends proved root to Hub via LayerZero with correct payload encoding.
properties.anti_property: Root relayed with incorrect encoding or to wrong destination.
properties.reachability_rationale: LayerZero message encoding is deterministic. Hub EID is configured at deployment.

properties.property: STATE-ROOT-RELAYED implies LayerZero message submitted for cross-chain delivery.
properties.anti_property: STATE-ROOT-RELAYED reached without message submission.
properties.reachability_rationale: State reached after successful _lzSend call. LayerZero handles delivery.

properties.property: STATE-HUB-IDLE represents Hub ready to receive roots and trigger broadcasts.
properties.anti_property: Hub stuck in non-responsive state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub operations are stateless per-call. No blocking state.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT validates source EID against registered Verifier list before processing.
properties.anti_property: Hub accepts root from unauthorized source.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL: _lzReceive implementation checks source EID against registered peers. Unknown sources are rejected.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT stores root in correct token index slot.
properties.anti_property: Root stored in wrong token slot corrupting aggregation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Token index derived from source EID mapping. Deterministic assignment.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED implies transferRoots[tokenIndex] contains new root.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED reached without storage update.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emitted after storage update. Atomic transaction.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST allows broadcast trigger by authorized caller.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast blocked indefinitely.
properties.reachability_rationale: broadcast() is a public function callable by anyone. No blocking mechanism.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION computes PoseidonT3 tree correctly over <= 64 token roots.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation tree computed with incorrect hash function or structure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Implementation uses audited PoseidonT3 library with fixed height-6 tree structure.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ increments aggSeq monotonically.
properties.anti_property: aggSeq decremented or reset.
properties.reachability_rationale: aggSeq uses post-increment (aggSeq++). No decrement function exists.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT sends aggregation root to all registered Verifiers.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast omits some registered Verifiers.
properties.reachability_rationale: Implementation iterates over all registered Verifier EIDs. Complete enumeration.

properties.property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST implies LayerZero messages sent to all registered Verifiers.
properties.anti_property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST reached with partial message delivery.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast loop completes atomically. If any message fails, transaction reverts.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT validates source EID is authorized Hub before storage.
properties.anti_property: Verifier accepts global root from unauthorized source.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL: _lzReceive checks source EID == hubEid. Unauthorized sources rejected.

properties.property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED implies globalTransferRoots[aggSeq] contains received root.
properties.anti_property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED reached without storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emitted after storage. Atomic transaction.

properties.property: STATE-INDEXER-IDLE represents off-chain indexer ready to process events.
properties.anti_property: Indexer unavailable blocking user operations.
properties.reachability_rationale: Off-chain service availability is operational responsibility, not security property.

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS captures all IndexedTransfer events without loss.
properties.anti_property: Indexer misses events creating inconsistent Merkle tree.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event capture depends on RPC reliability. Missing events will cause proof generation failure, not security breach.

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE constructs Merkle tree matching on-chain hash chain computation.
properties.anti_property: Indexer tree differs from on-chain computation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer uses same algorithm as on-chain. Proofs from mismatched tree will fail on-chain verification.

properties.property: STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY implies Merkle tree is consistent with on-chain state.
properties.anti_property: Indexer reports ready with inconsistent tree.
properties.reachability_rationale: Tree consistency verified by successful proof verification on-chain.

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS provides valid Merkle inclusion proofs.
properties.anti_property: Indexer provides invalid proofs causing circuit failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Invalid proofs will cause ZK circuit to fail. On-chain verification catches any errors.

properties.property: STATE-PROVER-IDLE represents decider-prover service ready for proof conversion.
properties.anti_property: Prover service unavailable blocking teleports.
properties.reachability_rationale: Off-chain service availability is operational responsibility.

properties.property: ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC accepts Nova IVC proofs from any user.
properties.anti_property: Prover censors specific users.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover censorship is operational issue. Users can run own prover if service censors.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-QUEUED implies job stored for processing.
properties.anti_property: Job lost after submission.
properties.reachability_rationale: Job persistence is operational responsibility.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-PROCESSING implies job actively being converted to Groth16.
properties.anti_property: Job stuck in processing indefinitely.
properties.reachability_rationale: Processing time is operational concern, not security property.

properties.property: ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 produces valid Groth16 proof preserving IVC semantics.
properties.anti_property: Conversion produces invalid or semantically different proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova-to-Groth16 conversion uses sonobe/ark-groth16 libraries. Conversion preserves public inputs. Invalid proofs rejected on-chain.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-COMPLETED implies valid Groth16 proof available for retrieval.
properties.anti_property: Job marked completed with invalid or missing proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Job completion status set after proof generation. Invalid proofs caught on-chain.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-FAILED indicates proof conversion failure with error details.
properties.anti_property: Job fails silently without error indication.
properties.reachability_rationale: Failure state is informational for user retry.

properties.property: STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE represents Adaptor ready to process bridge requests.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor blocked from processing requests.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor is stateless per-call. No blocking mechanism.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE validates bridge parameters including slippage limits.
properties.anti_property: Bridge request processed with invalid parameters.
properties.reachability_rationale: Parameter validation occurs before external calls. Invalid params revert.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM correctly invokes LiquidityManager unwrap.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor bypasses LiquidityManager for unwrap.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() with proper authorization.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE enforces minAmountOut slippage protection.
properties.anti_property: Bridge proceeds without slippage protection.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate.send() includes minAmountOut parameter enforced by bridge.

properties.property: STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED implies unwrap complete and Stargate bridge request submitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED reached without unwrap completion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential execution ensures unwrap before bridge.

properties.property: STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED indicates bridge operation failure with funds remaining safe.
properties.anti_property: Bridge fails with funds lost.
properties.reachability_rationale: Bridge failure handling depends on Stargate error recovery mechanisms.

properties.property: ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH produces cryptographically secure stealth address from secret.
properties.anti_property: Stealth address predictable without knowledge of secret.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth address derivation uses keccak256 and Poseidon hashing with PoW validation.

properties.property: ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF generates valid IVC proof from user's transfer history.
properties.anti_property: User generates proof for transfers they don't own.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit verifies secret-to-address binding. Only secret holder can generate valid proof.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF implies user holds valid IVC proof for claimed transfers.
properties.anti_property: User claims proof for transfers they don't own.
properties.reachability_rationale: IVC proof validity verified during generation. Invalid proofs rejected on-chain.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS can only be called by owner during emergency state.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner rotates verifiers or rotation occurs outside emergency.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations are out of audit scope per trust model.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY can only be called by owner after verifier rotation.
properties.anti_property: Emergency deactivated without proper verifier rotation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations are out of audit scope per trust model.

properties.property: STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED implies new verifiers active and emergency flag cleared.
properties.anti_property: Recovery state reached with stale verifiers or active emergency.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations are out of audit scope per trust model.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP requires valid wrap amount within BN254 constraints and user balance.
properties.anti_property: User initiates wrap with invalid amount bypassing validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Validation occurs at LiquidityManager entry. Invalid amounts revert before state change.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD transition uses IncentiveLib with correct parameters.
properties.anti_property: Reward calculation uses incorrect liquidity or curve parameters.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib reads current contract state atomically. Parameters cannot be modified mid-transaction.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY uses SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom for secure token transfer.
properties.anti_property: Transfer fails silently without proper revert.
properties.reachability_rationale: SafeERC20 wrapper handles non-standard ERC20 return values and reverts on failure.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 mints exact (amount + reward) to user.
properties.anti_property: Minting amount differs from calculated total.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mint amount computed from wrap amount + IncentiveLib reward in same transaction.

properties.property: EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE emits Wrapped event with accurate parameters.
properties.anti_property: Event emitted with incorrect values.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event parameters populated from transaction state. Cannot differ from actual operation.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 implies user balance increased by minted amount.
properties.anti_property: User balance not updated after successful wrap.
properties.reachability_rationale: ERC20._mint atomically updates balance. No path bypasses update.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP requires valid unwrap amount within user's zERC20 balance.
properties.anti_property: User initiates unwrap exceeding their balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. ERC20 balance check in burn operation reverts insufficient balance.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE uses ceiling division for protocol protection.
properties.anti_property: Fee calculation uses floor division allowing underpayment.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib implements explicit ceiling division for fees.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 burns exact unwrap amount from user.
properties.anti_property: Burn amount differs from requested unwrap.
properties.reachability_rationale: Burn amount equals input parameter. Atomic operation.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING transfers (amount - fee) using SafeERC20.
properties.anti_property: Transfer amount differs from (amount - fee).
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer amount computed from input minus fee in same transaction.

properties.property: EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE emits Unwrapped event with accurate parameters.
properties.anti_property: Event emitted with incorrect unwrap details.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event populated from transaction state.

properties.property: EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY correctly detects and reverts on liquidity shortage.
properties.anti_property: Unwrap proceeds despite insufficient liquidity.
properties.reachability_rationale: Liquidity check is explicit: require(amount <= underlyingBalance - feeSurplus).

properties.property: EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING implies underlying tokens transferred to user.
properties.anti_property: User doesn't receive underlying after successful unwrap.
properties.reachability_rationale: SafeERC20.safeTransfer reverts on failure. Success implies transfer complete.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER validates value <= 2^248-1 and sender balance.
properties.anti_property: Transfer initiated with value > 2^248-1 or exceeding balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Value checked in _afterTokenTransfer, balance in _transfer.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE applies BN254 constraint to recipient balance post-transfer.
properties.anti_property: Constraint check bypassed for certain transfers.
properties.reachability_rationale: _afterTokenTransfer hook is called for all transfers including mint/burn.

properties.property: EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE correctly triggers ValueTooLarge revert.
properties.anti_property: Value > 2^248-1 proceeds without revert.
properties.reachability_rationale: Explicit comparison: if (value > MAX_VALUE) revert ValueTooLarge().

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES atomically updates both sender and recipient balances.
properties.anti_property: Balance update is non-atomic or partial.
properties.reachability_rationale: OpenZeppelin _transfer is atomic with checks-effects-interactions pattern.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN appends (to, value) to hash chain deterministically.
properties.anti_property: Hash chain updated with incorrect data or non-deterministically.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash chain computation: sha256(hashChain || to || value) truncated to 248 bits. Deterministic.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT emits IndexedTransfer with monotonic index.
properties.anti_property: Event omitted or emitted with non-monotonic index.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emitted in _afterTokenTransfer with index++ ensuring monotonicity.

properties.property: EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE implies all state updates (balance, hash, event) complete.
properties.anti_property: Transfer marked complete with partial state updates.
properties.reachability_rationale: Atomic transaction ensures all-or-nothing execution.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT requires valid Groth16 proof and monotonic totalTeleported.
properties.anti_property: Teleport accepted with invalid proof or non-monotonic total.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. ZKP verification and monotonicity check protect against forged proofs and double-spend.

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT stores immutable checkpoint for proof binding.
properties.anti_property: Checkpoint modified or replaced after reservation.
properties.reachability_rationale: reservedHashChains mapping is write-once per index.

properties.property: EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB validates source EID is authorized Verifier before processing payload.
properties.anti_property: Hub accepts message from unauthorized source EID.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Hub._lzReceive validates sender against registered peer list.

properties.property: EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER validates source EID is authorized Hub before storing global root.
properties.anti_property: Verifier accepts global root from unauthorized source.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Verifier._lzReceive validates sender == hubEid.

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO sends proved root with correct encoding to LayerZero.
properties.anti_property: Root sent with incorrect encoding or destination.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Message encoding is deterministic. Destination configured at deployment.

properties.property: EDGE-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO broadcasts to all registered Verifiers without omission.
properties.anti_property: Some Verifiers not included in broadcast.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Broadcast iterates complete verifier list.

properties.property: EDGE-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE enforces minAmountOut slippage protection.
properties.anti_property: Bridge request sent without slippage protection.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Stargate.send includes minAmountOut parameter.

properties.property: EDGE-STARGATE-TO-ADAPTOR validates sender is authorized Stargate endpoint and amount meets slippage.
properties.anti_property: lzCompose accepts callback from unauthorized sender or with slippage exceeded.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. lzCompose validates msg.sender == endpoint and _from is registered pool.

properties.property: EDGE-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20 requires caller is authorized minter.
properties.anti_property: Non-minter address successfully calls mint/burn.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. onlyMinter modifier verifies msg.sender == minter().

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT requires caller is authorized verifier and proof is valid.
properties.anti_property: Non-verifier address or invalid proof results in unauthorized minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. zERC20.teleport() verifies msg.sender == verifier(). Proof validated before call.
properties.notes: CRITICAL: Verifier-to-zERC20 trust boundary for teleport minting.

properties.property: EDGE-OWNER-UPGRADE requires caller is contract owner.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner triggers contract upgrade.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope. Compensating controls: multisig, monitoring.
properties.notes: Owner trust boundary - out of scope.

properties.property: EDGE-OWNER-SET-MINTER requires caller is contract owner.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner changes minter address.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope. CRITICAL: No timelock - immediate effect.
properties.notes: Owner trust boundary - out of scope.

properties.property: EDGE-OWNER-REGISTER-TOKEN requires caller is contract owner.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner registers token on Hub.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope.
properties.notes: Owner trust boundary - out of scope.

properties.property: EDGE-OWNER-SET-VERIFIERS requires caller is contract owner.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner rotates verifier set.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope. CRITICAL: No timelock - immediate rotation.
properties.notes: Owner trust boundary - out of scope.

properties.property: EDGE-OWNER-SET-FEE-PARAMS requires caller is contract owner.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner modifies fee parameters.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope. Misconfiguration is INFORMATIONAL severity.
properties.notes: Owner trust boundary - out of scope.

properties.property: EDGE-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER provides proof verified on-chain by soundness.
properties.anti_property: Prover provides invalid proof accepted on-chain.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Proof validity guaranteed by Groth16 soundness. Invalid proofs rejected by verifier contract.

properties.property: EDGE-INDEXER-OUTPUT-TO-USER provides Merkle proofs verified during circuit execution.
properties.anti_property: Indexer provides invalid Merkle proof causing circuit failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: TRUST BOUNDARY EDGE. Invalid Merkle proofs cause ZK circuit to fail. User gets failed proof, not security breach.

properties.property: Nova IVC proof generation produces valid proof only for transfers owned by user's secret.
properties.anti_property: User generates valid IVC proof for transfers they don't own.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit verifies secret-to-address binding using compute_burn_address_from_secret(). Only the holder of the secret can generate proofs for their transfers.

properties.property: Nova-to-Groth16 conversion preserves semantic equivalence of proven statement.
properties.anti_property: Conversion produces proof with different public inputs or semantics.
properties.reachability_rationale: Conversion uses verified sonobe/ark-groth16 libraries. Public inputs extracted from IVC and encoded into Groth16 proof.

properties.property: Transfer root proof verification correctly validates ZKP and detects divergent proofs.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proof accepted or valid proof rejected.
properties.reachability_rationale: IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof implements Groth16 verification. Divergent proofs trigger emergency state.

properties.property: Withdrawal proof verification correctly validates Nova or Groth16 proof and extracts public inputs.
properties.anti_property: Withdrawal proceeds with invalid proof or incorrect public input extraction.
properties.reachability_rationale: Withdrawal deciders implement Groth16 verification. Public inputs extracted from verified proof structure.

properties.property: Incentive curve calculation uses correct rounding (floor for rewards, ceiling for fees).
properties.anti_property: Rounding favors user over protocol allowing extraction.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib explicitly uses floor for rewards and ceiling for fees. Mathematical integration bounds clamped to [0, T].

properties.property: Hub aggregation correctly computes PoseidonT3 Merkle tree over registered token roots.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation produces incorrect root due to wrong hash function or tree structure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub uses audited PoseidonT3 library with circom-compatible configuration. Height-6 tree for <= 64 tokens.

properties.property: LayerZero message flow validates source EID before processing payload.
properties.anti_property: Message from unauthorized source accepted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub and Verifier _lzReceive implementations validate source EID against registered peer list.

properties.property: Stealth address generation produces cryptographically unlinkable addresses from secret.
properties.anti_property: Stealth address can be linked back to identity without secret knowledge.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth addresses use Poseidon hashing with secret binding. PoW adds computational cost to enumeration attacks.

properties.property: Poseidon hash implementation is collision-resistant and circom-compatible.
properties.anti_property: Collision found or incompatibility with circom implementation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Uses audited light-poseidon library with circom-compatible parameters. Mathematical collision resistance.

properties.property: Baby JubJub curve operations are mathematically correct on BN254-embedded curve.
properties.anti_property: Point addition or scalar multiplication produces incorrect result.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mathematical correctness of twisted Edwards curve arithmetic. Audited library implementation.

properties.property: IC canister interactions provide confidential key derivation and encrypted storage.
properties.anti_property: Keys leaked or encrypted state compromised.
properties.reachability_rationale: IC infrastructure trust is SEMI_TRUSTED per trust model. Key derivation uses vetKd canister.

properties.property: Stargate bridge flow enforces slippage protection and handles refunds correctly.
properties.anti_property: User loses funds due to slippage or failed refund.
properties.reachability_rationale: minAmountOut parameter enforced by Stargate. Slippage exceeded triggers refund path.

properties.property: Nova folding scheme correctly accumulates proofs maintaining IVC soundness.
properties.anti_property: Folding produces invalid accumulator or loses soundness.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova folding uses sonobe/folding-schemes library. Mathematical soundness of relaxed R1CS folding.

properties.property: SelfCall pattern prevents external reentrancy to protected functions.
properties.anti_property: External caller invokes onlySelfCall function.
properties.reachability_rationale: onlySelfCall modifier checks (msg.sender == address(this) && selfCallEnabled). Both conditions required.

properties.property: Native ETH handling validates msg.value and properly wraps to WETH.
properties.anti_property: ETH stuck in contract or msg.value mismatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: msg.value validation ensures exact amount. Excess refunded to sender.

properties.property: Governance functions require onlyOwner modifier.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner executes administrative function.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner operations out of audit scope per trust model. All use onlyOwner modifier.

properties.property: lzCompose callback validates sender is LayerZero endpoint and origin is registered Stargate pool.
properties.anti_property: lzCompose accepts callback from unauthorized sender or unknown pool.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL: lzCompose validates msg.sender == endpoint and _from in registered pools. Failed composes stored for retry.

properties.property: The ZKP system (Nova + Groth16) maintains 128-bit security level and soundness.
properties.anti_property: Attacker forges valid proof for statement they cannot prove honestly.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Groth16 provides 128-bit security under trusted setup assumption. Nova folding preserves soundness. Forging a proof requires breaking discrete log on BN254.
properties.notes: Foundation security property - all teleports depend on this.

properties.property: No valid teleport can be executed twice (double-spend prevention via monotonic totalTeleported).
properties.anti_property: Attacker executes same teleport proof multiple times.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. totalTeleported[recipient] is strictly increasing. Proof encodes cumulative amount. Re-submission fails monotonicity check.

properties.property: Cross-chain messages are authenticated via source EID validation.
properties.anti_property: Attacker injects unauthorized message accepted by Hub or Verifier.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. All _lzReceive implementations validate source EID against registered peer list. LayerZero guardian supermajority (13/19) provides message integrity.

properties.property: zERC20 minting can only occur through two authorized pathways: LiquidityManager.mint() and Verifier.teleport().
properties.anti_property: Unauthorized address mints zERC20 tokens.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. zERC20.mint() restricted to minter(). zERC20.teleport() restricted to verifier(). Both set by owner during deployment.

properties.property: All zERC20 values are constrained to <= 2^248-1 for BN254 scalar field compatibility.
properties.anti_property: Value > 2^248-1 stored in zERC20 corrupting ZK circuit compatibility.
properties.reachability_rationale: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. _afterTokenTransfer hook enforces MAX_VALUE check on all transfers/mints. Values exceeding limit revert with ValueTooLarge.

properties.property: Adaptor SelfCall-protected functions (unwrapSelf, bridgeUnderlyingTokenSelf, bridgeZerc20Self) cannot be invoked by external callers.
properties.anti_property: External caller directly invokes unwrapSelf or bridgeZerc20Self bypassing intended flow.
properties.reachability_rationale: onlySelfCall modifier requires both msg.sender == address(this) AND _isSelfCallAllowed flag. External callers fail first condition; direct contract calls fail second condition.

properties.property: Adaptor user balance mappings (zerc20Balances, nativeBalances, underlingTokenBalances) correctly track pending balances and are properly debited on withdraw.
properties.anti_property: User withdraws more than their recorded balance or balance accounting desyncs from actual tokens.
properties.reachability_rationale: Balances zeroed before transfer (checks-effects-interactions). Each balance type handled independently. _debitCombinedNativeBalance correctly aggregates native sources.
properties.notes: Adaptor balance management for failed compose handling.

properties.property: IncentiveLib._validateFeeParams correctly rejects invalid fee parameters (zero target, excessive target, excessive k, overflow-inducing combinations).
properties.anti_property: Invalid fee parameters pass validation causing division by zero, overflow, or excessive fees.
properties.reachability_rationale: _validateFeeParams checks: T > 0, T <= MAX_TARGET_LIQUIDITY, k <= K_BPS_DENOM, k <= max/T/T. All paths validated before storage.

properties.property: IncentiveLib computations cannot overflow uint256 due to validated parameter bounds.
properties.anti_property: k * T * T or intermediate calculations overflow causing incorrect reward/fee values.
properties.reachability_rationale: _validateFeeParams enforces k <= type(uint256).max / T / T. With k <= 10000 and T <= MAX_TARGET_LIQUIDITY, overflow is impossible.
properties.notes: Arithmetic overflow prevention in incentive calculations.

properties.property: IncentiveLib correctly handles edge cases: L=0 (max incentive), L=T (zero incentive), L>T (zero incentive), amount=0 (zero result).
properties.anti_property: Edge cases produce incorrect reward/fee values or revert unexpectedly.
properties.reachability_rationale: Density function ρ(x) = k × (1 - x/T) correctly yields k at x=0, 0 at x=T, and clamped to 0 for x>T. Integration bounds clamped to [0,T].

properties.property: Calling enableSelfCall when _isSelfCallAllowed is already true reverts with SelfCallAlreadyEnabled.
properties.anti_property: Nested enableSelfCall calls succeed, potentially corrupting state.
properties.reachability_rationale: enableSelfCall() checks _isSelfCallAllowed == false as precondition. Nested calls revert before setting flag again.

properties.property: LiquidityManager receive() only accepts ETH when _isNativeUnderlying is true (underlying is WETH).
properties.anti_property: ETH sent to LiquidityManager with non-native underlying is accepted and stuck.
properties.reachability_rationale: receive() checks _isNativeUnderlying storage flag. Non-native underlying reverts with NativeTokenNotSupported, preventing ETH from being stuck.

properties.property: LiquidityManager maintains underlyingBalance >= feeSurplus invariant to ensure fee surplus can always be withdrawn.
properties.anti_property: feeSurplus exceeds underlying balance causing withdrawRewards to fail or unwrap to incorrectly succeed.
properties.reachability_rationale: unwrap checks amount <= underlyingBalance - feeSurplus. Fees are added to feeSurplus on each unwrap. withdrawRewards cannot exceed feeSurplus.

properties.property: IMintableBurnableERC20 interface implementations (zERC20) require onlyMinter authorization for mint and burn functions.
properties.anti_property: Unauthorized caller invokes mint or burn on zERC20 via IMintableBurnableERC20 interface.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20.mint() and zERC20.burn() use onlyMinter modifier. minter() returns LiquidityManager address set during initialization.

reachability_analysis_summary.methodology: Graph traversal from untrusted actor nodes through all possible paths. Anti-properties checked against validation requirements at each trust boundary crossing.

key_validation_chokepoints.description: All teleport paths require successful ZKP verification
All teleports require strictly increasing totalTeleported
All cross-chain messages require source EID validation
All minting requires onlyMinter or onlyVerifier authorization
All value transfers require BN254 field constraint check

critical_boundaries.protection: Source EID validation + LayerZero guardian supermajority
Source EID validation + LayerZero guardian supermajority
Endpoint validation + pool whitelist + slippage check
